name: AniList ↔ MAL Sync
description: Bidirectional AniList and MyAnimeList synchronization for anime and manga in Seanime.
author: AleBoss72
notes: AniList ↔ MyAnimeList sync for anime and manga. Includes built-in MAL API client setup, hosted callback UX, automatic migration from legacy localhost redirect URIs, explicit logout, inline high-contrast tray icon, and stable update channel. Based on nnotwen/MyAnimeListSync (MIT).
